before.name: Stratospheric ozone
before.notes: Montreal Protocol success story. Ozone layer is recovering globally. Local contribution is minimal. Focus is on proper disposal of old refrigerants/AC units.

after.name: Extreme heat exposure
after.geography: Santa Cruz County proxy — not city limits
after.notes: CDC EJI 2024 reports tract means of locally extreme heat days during 2018–2022, defined using a local 95th-percentile maximum-temperature threshold. Population-weighted county mean: 14.757709506983256 days/year across 69 EJI tracts. Census 2020 coverage was independently checked; the omitted tract has zero population and zero land area. No safe annual-day target was established, so target, score and wedge must remain null. For Santa Cruz city and Watsonville, this is explicitly a Santa Cruz County proxy, not a city-limit observation. Integration requires an explicit local-extreme-heat-v1 profile replacing the legacy ozone dimension for these three portraits only.
